title: Lamarck's Driving School: Discovering Autonomous Driving Training Strategies through Evolutionary Competition
abstract: arXiv:2610.11662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous driving capabilities depend strongly on the distribution of scenarios encountered during training. Existing methods commonly construct or dynamically adapt training scenario distributions using surrogate criteria such as realism, difficulty, or risk. However, these predefined surrogates may misrepresent training value, leading to inefficient use of training resources. To address this limitation, we propose a Lamarckian evolutionary framework that replaces surrogate-based guidance with competition among candidate distributions. We formulate training strategy discovery as a multi-stage bilevel optimization problem and use Lamarckian evolution algorithm to approximate its solution. translated_title: 拉马克驾校：通过进化竞争发现自动驾驶训练策略
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶能力在很大程度上取决于训练过程中所遇到场景的分布。现有方法通常使用诸如真实性、难度或风险等替代性指标来构建或动态调整训练场景分布。然而，这些预先定义的替代指标可能无法准确反映训练价值，导致训练资源的使用效率低下。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一个拉马克式进化框架，用候选分布之间的竞争来取代基于替代指标的引导。我们将训练策略发现问题形式化为一个多阶段双层优化问题，并利用拉马克式进化算法来逼近其解。在外层，达尔文式的交叉、变异和选择机制探索场景分布空间；在内层，策略学习获取新能力，而拉马克式遗传将这些能力传递给后续阶段，从而使场景分（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种拉马克式进化框架，将自动驾驶训练策略发现形式化为多阶段双层优化问题，用候选场景分布之间的竞争取代传统的替代指标引导，通过外层达尔文式探索与内层拉马克式遗传相结合，实现更高效的训练策略发现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Lamarckian evolutionary framework that formulates autonomous driving training strategy discovery as a multi-stage bilevel optimization problem, replacing surrogate-based guidance with competition among candidate scenario distributions, combining Darwinian exploration at the outer level with Lamarckian inheritance at the inner level for more efficient training strategy discovery.
